title: Firefly 2026-08-19: Zeno Survive-the-Night Package on Blue Ghost; 5 Watts thermal Am-241 RHU; NET 2028
note: 5 Wt is heat (RHU), not electrical bus watts. Electrical keep-alive W not printed. Store Wh not printed. Firefly does not print CS-8. Does not print 400 W on this package. BGM1 is a different mission.
quote_thermal: Zeno’s payload is comprised of a 5 Watts thermal americium-241 RHU and dedicated platform that includes structural, communications, electrical power, command and data handling, and thermal management subsystems.
quote_net: Scheduled to launch no earlier than 2028
quote_night_ops: Zeno’s payload will then operate during the lunar night and transmit operational data back to Earth.
quote_solar_day: Upon landing, Blue Ghost will first operate multiple NASA CLPS payloads using solar power for the full lunar day, equivalent to approximately 14 Earth days.
quote_heat: The RHU generates passive thermal energy through the natural decay of radioactive material, providing continuous heat without relying on solar power.
